findings.headline: Strongly cooling-driven consumption
findings.action: Check chiller sequencing, cooling setpoints and simultaneous heating/cooling; look at solar gain on the affected facades.
findings.would_rule_out: Expected in a hot climate; compare against peers at the same site before drawing a conclusion.

findings.headline: Little or no weekend setback
findings.action: Check that the weekend schedule differs from the weekday one, and that holiday calendars are configured.
findings.would_rule_out: Expected where the building genuinely operates seven days a week.

caveat: Hypotheses to check on site, not conclusions. Each finding lists what would explain it legitimately.
